individual-data-points.explanation: Flow cytometry dot/density plots display individual cellular events directly; scatter-type plots are exempt from requiring separately overlaid individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars or box-plot elements are present on these flow cytometry gating plots; gated population percentages are shown instead.

individual-data-points.explanation: Flow cytometry scatter/density plots show individual events directly; scatter-type plots are exempt from the individual-data-point requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars or box-plot elements are present; the panel shows gated population percentages (e.g., PC 86.5%).

individual-data-points.explanation: Flow cytometry scatter plots showing NP-binding GC/MBC gating display individual cellular events, exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars or box-plot elements are present; this is a gating strategy plot with population percentages.

individual-data-points.explanation: Color-coded overlay scatter plot where each point is an individual cell event; scatter plots are exempt from the individual-data-point requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars or box-plot elements are present on this color-coded scatter overlay.

individual-data-points.explanation: Flow cytometry scatter plots showing MBC subset gating display individual cellular events, exempt from the individual-data-point requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars or box-plot elements are present; gated subset percentages (e.g., 52.6%, 43.3%, 60.5%, 7.1%) are shown instead.
